title: Take 3 to 5 grams of creatine monohydrate daily.
subtitle: Supplement staple
rationale: Use the single best-studied performance supplement to support strength, training volume, and possibly cognition.

evidence.summary: Position-stand evidence supports creatine monohydrate as safe and effective for strength and lean mass across hundreds of trials.

indications: Strength training is consistent but unsupplemented.
Muscle or strength progression is an explicit goal.
avoidWhen: Kidney disease or impaired renal function unless cleared by a physician.
